channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Herb Jones | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Herb Jones from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Herb Jones
item.description:
Joe Dumars on Herb Jones:

“Herb Jones exemplifies all the great qualities our team values with his toughness, competitiveness, and commitment to getting better every day. We could not be more excited to sign Herb to this contract extension and keep him in New Orleans for many years to come.”

Joe Dumars on Herb Jones, Jul 14, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Herb Jones
item.description:
Dejounte Murray on Herb Jones:

“He's a dog, a competitor. He loves the game. He takes pride in any matchup he has... I was telling my family, we're going to be arguing about who gets to guard the best player (on the opposing team).”

Dejounte Murray on Herb Jones, Jul 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Herb Jones
item.description:
Will Guillory:Dejounte Murray on Herb Jones:

“He's legit. I want to challenge him. I want him to challenge me, starting in practice. I want to be on First Team All-Defense with him. That's something I've been preaching since the trade happened.”

Dejounte Murray on Herb Jones, Jul 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Ryan Dunn on Paul George, OG Anunoby, Herb Jones
item.description:
Ryan Dunn:

“There are a lot of players I watch like Paul George and Herb Jones too defensively. I think the closest I probably have is OG Anunoby right now with him in the playoffs with his size and strength defensively.”

Ryan Dunn on Paul George, OG Anunoby, Herb Jones, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Herb Jones
item.description:
Gregg Popovich on Herb Jones' defense:

“Avoid him like the plague. ... I'm serious. I told my guys, 'If he's there, pass it to someone else'.”

Gregg Popovich on Herb Jones, Apr 5, 2024. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Herb Jones
item.description:
Zion Williamson on Herb Jones:

“If Herb is not First Team (All-Defense), I don't know what else someone can do to qualify for that.”

Zion Williamson on Herb Jones, Feb 23, 2024. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Jordan Hawkins on Herb Jones
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Jordan Hawkins on Herb Jones defense:

“It's really impressive. I've never seen anyone who can sit down (in a stance) and guard anyone (positions) 1 through 5.That's what makes him so special and hard to take off the floor.”

Jordan Hawkins on Herb Jones, Oct 30, 2023. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Herb Jones
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Tom Thibodeau on #Pelicans rookie starting forward:

“Herb Jones is a terrific basketball player. (For) people that don't know him well, he's very, very good.”

Tom Thibodeau on Herb Jones, Jan 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Willie Green on Herb Jones
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Willie Green on Herbert Jones being given the toughest defensive assignments, even though he's a rookie:

“In this league, you get thrown in the fire when you're that good. He's going to continue to get better and learn. His progression from the start to now, it's a huge jump.”

Willie Green on Herb Jones, Jan 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Devonte Graham on Herb Jones
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Devonte' Graham on Herbert Jones (career-high 19 pts vs. Den):

“He’s just getting more comfortable, more confident. The ball’s starting to go in. Like you said, he’s working on his jumper every day, so you love to see it. He’s putting in the work and it’s paying off for him.”

Devonte Graham on Herb Jones, Dec 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Devonte Graham on Herb Jones, Trey Murphy
item.description:
Oleh Kosel:Devonte' Graham on tonight's @BallySportsNO interview about Trey Murphy III and Herb Jones:

“My two rook's, man, oh my God, man, they're gonna be good. I've been telling people that back home.”

Devonte Graham on Herb Jones, Trey Murphy, Oct 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @OlehKosel.
